settings.q: How do I find all designs from one anime?
settings.a: Use the Anime tab at the top. Every anime has its own page, for example Naruto or Jujutsu Kaisen, and you can also search a character like Itachi or Sukuna.

settings.q: What is the difference between Oversized and Regular fit?
settings.a: Oversized is wider with dropped shoulders. Regular is a classic straight fit. Each product page shows the price for each fit.

settings.q: Do you deliver across the UAE?
settings.a: Yes, to all emirates, free on every order. Delivery takes 1–3 business days.

settings.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
settings.a: Yes. You can also pay by card or Apple Pay at checkout.
Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging. For a different size, return the item and place a new order, or message us on WhatsApp.

settings.q: Can you print my own design?
settings.a: Yes. Open Custom Print, pick the garment, print area and size, and upload or send your design.
